Important information about wheels and t: - Use only tyres and wheels approved by CUPRA.
- Mixing different types of tyres may affect safety and performance.
- Check tyre condition and tread depth regularly.
- Tyre pressure must match the specifications on the label in the door frame.
- Driving with incorrect tyre pressure increases wear and fuel consumption.
- Replace damaged or aged tyres even if they have sufficient tread.
Changing a wheel: - Only change the wheel in a safe location on solid ground.
- Engage the electronic parking brake and use hazard warning lights.
- Use the vehicle’s tool kit and follow the steps precisely.
- Loosen wheel bolts before lifting the car with the jack.
- Replace with a spare or temporary wheel and tighten bolts securely.
- Have the damaged tyre inspected and repaired or replaced as soon as possible.
Tyre pressure monitor system: - Monitors tyre pressure and alerts the driver of significant loss.
- Calibration is required after adjusting pressure or changing tyres.
- Alerts appear on the instrument cluster display.
- The system does not detect gradual pressure loss from natural leakage.
- Always calibrate the system through the infotainment menu after checking pressures.
